title: Archives updates
summary: Connected the farm archive feed, updated the staff directory, improved logging and monitoring, and added log rotation and archival.
description: Improved the farm archive feed, fixed the buggy logging, staff & retired list.

body.text: The archive now reads the dated farms.jsonl feed so new farm records, videos, worlds, and schematics appear without replacing the existing catalog.
Added new staff members and updated existing profiles to reflect current roles and responsibilities. Retired staff members were added to the directory for historical reference.
Improved logging and monitoring to better track application performance and user activity, with more detailed debug logs and better alerting for critical issues.
Posted polished logs to https://theysix.tech/logs for better accessibility and long-term storage, and set up log rotation to manage disk space efficiently.
